root_idea.summary: The root centers on undoing, untying, or breaking apart something previously made firm, compact, or coherent; it also has a related sound branch associated with cracking or rupture.
root_idea.development: The physical sense extends from untying ropes, dismantling structures, and unraveling woven material to annulling covenants and contradicting statements. A related development describes sounds produced when joints, structures, or other things crack or come apart.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Normalized from the inflected QAC form نَقَضَتْ to the Form I perfect citation form نَقَضَ.
Displayed as the Form IV perfect citation form أَنقَضَ.
Displayed under the normalized verbal-noun citation form نَقْضٌ rather than the inflected Quranic form نَقْضِ.

senses.definition: To undo, unravel, or untwist something made compact or interlaced.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Qur'an, used of spun yarn being untwisted; the physical action reverses a previously formed or tightened arrangement.

senses.definition: To break, annul, or repudiate a covenant, oath, or binding undertaking.
senses.usage_conditions: A figurative extension of undoing something made firm; used with covenants, God's covenant, and oaths.

senses.definition: To press heavily upon or burden a back, causing it to creak under the load.
senses.usage_conditions: Used in the Qur'an in the construction أَنْقَضَ ظَهْرَكَ; the sense concerns oppressive weight and the resulting sound or strain, not simply breaking.

senses.definition: Breaking or annulling a covenant or binding undertaking.
senses.usage_conditions: A verbal noun used in the genitive construction نَقْضِهِم, referring to their breaking of a covenant or pledge.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To take apart a building or structure, or to undo and unravel rope, fiber, cloth, or other compact material.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The action reverses a previously firm or compacted state and need not mean demolishing a structure completely.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To annul or undo a sale, an established affair, or the security of a fortified place.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension of undoing something that had been confirmed, settled, or made secure.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To take or exact another person's blood-revenge.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiomatic expression literally associated with undoing a bowstring.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To reverse what time or fortune had previously made firm or established.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative description of changing circumstances that undo an earlier consolidation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To undo, annul, or contradict another person's statement, especially by replying against it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a reply that invalidates or counters what another speaker or poet has said.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The shaking or movement of a roof's wooden pieces or rafters.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized expression for a roof whose components move, apparently producing a sound.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Contradiction or rebuttal in speech; contending with another by countering what they have said.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: May describe contradictory meanings within an utterance or an exchange in which each speaker rebuts the other.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To remove the earth's crust from over truffles or extract the truffles from the ground.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive Form IV usage concerning the harvesting of truffles.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For the earth's crust to break up or come away from over a truffle.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Describes the crust separating as the truffle is about to emerge.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For the earth to show or put forth its plants or herbage.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized intransitive Form IV usage applied to the earth.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To produce, emit, or utter a sound, noise, voice, or cry, especially a slight cracking or clicking sound.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of animate or inanimate things, including joints, fingers, ribs, saddles, birds, and other animals; the classification of animate versus inanimate subjects is reported with variation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make a clicking, smacking, or similar sound to urge, call, chide, or drive an animal.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A construction with بِـ used with beasts of carriage, camels, horses, goats, or similar animals.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make a back lean or emaciated through the pressure of a load.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reported extension of the back-burden construction beyond the resulting creaking sound.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For the earth to crack or burst open from over a truffle.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form V usage synonymous with the earth's crust breaking apart as the truffle emerges.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For a house, chamber, or building to become cleft or cracked in several places.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The cracking may be accompanied by sounds.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For a person's bones to make a cracking sound.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative or sound-related Form V usage associated with bones cracking.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be mutually contradictory or mutually repugnant.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of statements, meanings, sentences, or speakers when one part or position negates or undoes the other.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To mutually dissolve or break an agreement, sale, or covenant.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive or collective usage in which the parties jointly undo the binding arrangement.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become undone, unraveled, dissolved, broken, or otherwise lose the firmness previously given to it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The quasi-passive Form VIII is used of buildings, structures, ropes, woven materials, agreements, sales, and similar things.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become unsound, invalid, or unfortified after having been sound, healed, settled, or secure.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a wound becoming recurrent, an affair deteriorating, a defensive position becoming unfortified, or a state of ritual purity becoming annulled.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For poetry or a poetic statement to be undone, annulled, or contradicted by a reply.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative Form VIII usage applied to a poetic counter-response.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For a wall to crack without falling down.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form XI usage describing structural cracking that does not necessarily result in collapse.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Something undone, taken apart, unraveled, or pulled to pieces; especially material from tents, garments, or a hair-rope that has been unraveled and twisted again.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A noun for the result or material of undoing, including what has been dismantled or reworked.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An emaciated or jaded camel, horse, or other riding animal.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The condition is figuratively understood as though travel had unknit the animal's frame; a feminine form is also reported.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The place or crust of earth that breaks away from over a truffle.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A noun for the broken surface formed as truffles approach the ground's surface.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A contradictor, contrary, or thing inconsistent with another; also a poetic counter-statement that undoes another poem.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of mutually incompatible propositions and of poetic compositions composed in rebuttal.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A sound, noise, voice, or cry, including the sound of joints, fingers, ribs, saddles, animals, or other things.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This sound-related sense is separately reported in the lexical tradition and is subject to a disagreement about the preferred form and attribution.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Refraining or holding back.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A rare, isolated lexical usage reported as equivalent to مُتَرَيِّعٌ.

cautions: The Form IV Quranic usage أَنقَضَ ظَهْرَكَ concerns oppressive weight and the creaking or strain it causes; it should not be reduced to the ordinary Form I sense 'to break.'
A Lane passage under نِقْضٌ gives a honey-and-bees definition but explicitly identifies it as a mistranscription of نِفْضٌ, so it is excluded from the root's meanings.
The sound meaning reported under نَقِيضٌ is accompanied by an explicit lexical disagreement about the preferred form and attribution.
The meaning 'refraining or holding back' under مُنْتَقِضٌ is rare and isolated.
